title: "Eiyuu" Kaitai
justification: The node had no value at all. AniDB 12142 is a one-episode 28-minute OVA (2016-11-23) that TVDB lists only as the movie 「英雄」解体 (thetvdb.com/movies/eiyuu-kaitai), which links TMDB movie 557680 (Heroes Dismissed, 27 min, 2016-11-23) and IMDb tt19316714. With no TVDB series the node takes the OVA marker and the TMDB and IMDb ids.
